findings.question: 1530과 1540의 고해·회개 조항 대응은 무엇인가
findings.result: 1530 XI Confession corresponds by topic to 1540 XII Confession; 1530 XII Repentance corresponds to 1540 XI Repentance. A number-only join would pair unlike subjects.
findings.implication: Use topic-and-edition alignment, never raw article number alone

findings.question: 1540년 수정은 성만찬 제10조에만 국한되는가
findings.result: No. Schaff identifies alterations affecting Article IV and Article X among others, and separately warns German/Latin 1530 text differed.
findings.implication: Track language and witness in addition to year

findings.question: 취리히본(Z)과 헤센본(K)의 구체적 대조 위치
findings.result: Zurich archive documents three additions to articles 7, 13 and 15 in Z absent from K. It identifies the Hessian original as Hessisches StA Marburg Best. 3 Nr. 245 fol.60r–64v and edition references for Z/K comparison.

locations.shelfmark: Hessisches StA Marburg Best.3 Nr.245 fol.60r–64v

edition_leads.title: Die Bekenntnisschriften der Evangelisch-Lutherischen Kirche: Quellen und Materialien

findings.implication: Do not invent wording of Z additions before direct diplomatic comparison

findings.question: 중간 라틴어판의 실제 구조 변화
findings.result: Lane describes 1539 as 17 chapters, 1543 as 21, 1550 as introducing sections and 1559 as thorough reorganization; Bridwell confirms Latin succession 1536/1539/1543/1550/1559 and English Norton 1562.
findings.implication: Do not infer chapter equivalence across editions by numeric labels
